subject.title: Discord DM bot/tool posts can appear in channel UI but not in OpenClaw session history

question: Should successful OpenClaw-owned proactive sends to a Discord DM always be mirrored into the resolved destination conversation while external bot/webhook posts remain excluded unless accepted through the authorized inbound pipeline?
rationale: The existing delivery-mirror architecture supports OpenClaw-owned outbound continuity, but treating every Discord-visible post as session history would change the trust boundary and could inject unrelated or hostile external content into model context.

options.title: Mirror OpenClaw-owned sends
options.body: Persist successful message-tool and owned scheduled sends once in the resolved destination transcript, with source and originating-run metadata, while excluding unauthorised external posts.

options.title: Mirror every visible post
options.body: Ingest bot and webhook posts from Discord into the conversation transcript, requiring explicit authorization, provenance, deduplication, and prompt-injection safeguards.

options.title: Document separate histories
options.body: Keep proactive and external posts outside the destination transcript and make the UI and session tools clearly identify channel-visible content that is not session context.

recommendation.title: Mirror OpenClaw-owned sends
recommendation.body: Persist successful message-tool and owned scheduled sends once in the resolved destination transcript, with source and originating-run metadata, while excluding unauthorised external posts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the current outbound session-entry and transcript-mirroring contract central to this decision.
